Independent Auditor's Report

To the Shareholders of Sarybel Energy Holding JSC:

We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Sarybel Energy Holding JSC and its
subsidiaries (the “Group”), which comprise the consolidated statement of financial position as at 31
December 2025, and the consolidated statements of profit or loss, changes in equity and cash flows for
the year then ended, and notes, comprising significant accounting policies and other explanatory
information. In our opinion, the accompanying consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all
material respects, the consolidated financial position of the Group as at 31 December 2025, and its
consolidated financial performance and cash flows for the year then ended in accordance with
International Financial Reporting Standards.

Aral Bastau Audit LLP, Zheltoksan Street 16, Aktobe, Kazakhstan

All amounts in thousands of United States dollars unless otherwise stated

Note 6 — Segment Information

The Group’s thermal generation and network services segment is conducted through Ekibastuz Power
Services JSC, which operates and maintains generating plant and associated switchyards in the
Pavlodar region under long-term service concessions. Segment results are reported to the Group’s
chief operating decision-maker on a basis consistent with the consolidated financial statements above;
the operational metrics below are provided for context and are not a substitute for the audited financial
statements.

Selected Segment Operating Data                                            Year ended 31 Dec 2025
Installed generating capacity (MW)                                                                1,240
Generating units under service contract                                                                 8
Switchyards and substations maintained                                                                23
Average headcount during the year                                                                    612
Contracted availability achieved                                                                    94%

Operating data are presented for the standalone subsidiary and are unaudited. The subsidiary’s financial results are
consolidated within the Group statements above.

Note 7 — Property, Plant and Equipment
There were no disposals of property, plant and equipment during the year.
